name: Eligibility and claims mock pipeline
problem: Mock payer API integration with retries, idempotency and reconciliation of claims status.
limits: Synthetic eligibility/claim data only. A real FastAPI mock and HTTP client ASGI transport exercise request parsing, idempotency conflicts and polling. Chaos injects both pre-response timeouts and ambiguous POST timeouts after the payer commits. No real payer, billing, PHI, insurance decision or clinical workflow is used. In-memory stores demonstrate the protocol; persistence, authentication and cross-process durability are not covered. evidence/reconciliation.json includes terminal statuses, pending-before count and discrepancies. Eligibility is a declared deterministic fixture rule, not a benefits determination.
next: Persist request/receipt state and add reconciliation of partial outages across multiple mock payers.
